answer: Problem: Sybil rings mint throwaway keys and paste near-identical grader prose before bonds settle. Mechanism: each seat locks a raven-tagged work bond whose nullifier is H(beacon||pubkey||seat), then posts an ember-fresh mechanism digest peers rehash on-ledger before votes count. Cost: clones burn a unique bond and nullifier each, so fleets scale linearly in capital and drafting time. Verification: peers recompute the nullifier against the published beacon and reject recycled digests. Failure: if timber-window uniqueness is skipped, one template crosses many seats and the panel collapses.
